title: Remaining RFC 8620 §5.3 identical-value sites
description: Same bug class as t8ej.25 (reject identical server-set values), sites not covered by .25: jmap-scene-server asset.rs:460; jmap-tasks-server task.rs:383, task_list.rs:323; jmap-sharing-server principal.rs:306 (all reject_read_only_patch(.., None)); jmap-vtc-server media.rs VTCRecording update (~946) and VTCLivestream update (allow only 'state'); jmap-chat-server chat.rs and message.rs bad_props allow-lists; jmap-mail-server submission.rs process_update (~1052, only undoStatus). Apply the empty-patch no-op decision (on t8ej.25) too. NEEDS MARK: EmailSubmission fix requires changing tests/integration.rs::submission_set_update_only_undo_status_allowed (~4602), which sends an identical emailId expecting rejection. Minor gaps: no MDN/send empty onSuccessUpdateEmail no-op test (impl and reviewer disagree whether it is reachable); vtc participant no-op tests do not re-/get and compare. Open question: should unknown-only patches and {"addRoles": []} also be no-ops? (they still return invalidPatch).
notes:
DECISION (Mark 2026-11-01): YES fix EmailSubmission/set identical-value case. Change tests/integration.rs::submission_set_update_only_undo_status_allowed to send a DIFFERENT emailId (still expects invalidProperties); spec-driven input change, list in tests_changed.
DECISION (Mark 2026-11-02): unknown-only patches and empty structural arrays (e.g. {"addRoles": []}) stay errors (invalidPatch); only {} and identical-server-set-only patches are no-ops. No change needed.
From batch 46 review: (a) scene avatar.rs eject-key check runs on the raw patch before strip_read_only_patch, so an owner/admin eject that repeats an identical server-set value ({leftAt, id:<same>}) is forbidden, contrary to §5.3; compute eject key set after dropping identical values. (b) NEEDS MARK: Space/set on an OPEN Space, a caller without manage_space sending {} gets a no-op success because the permission check lives in backend apply_space_patch; fixing needs a new ChatBackend pre-check hook. (c) VTCParticipant update of a missing id with a read-only key is now notFound (was invalidProperties).
close_reason: children done in batch 50; leftovers filed
